reviews.summary: Independent baseline review found the complete record-load-reporting Change implemented and aligned with its goal; no target-scope defects found. Reviewer verified the shared presentation protocol, Build/Explore/Propose projections, four Contract deltas, task direction, consumed record snapshot and coverage. Reported focused and full-suite checks passed.

opt.reason: The Change is a narrow workflow-prompt and generated-projection update. Its focused and full template suites, lint, build, and independent baseline Review all passed; no optimization direction has evidence of additional user-visible benefit sufficient to justify more scope.

seal.testScope: pnpm exec vitest run test/core/templates (18 files, 229 tests); pnpm lint; pnpm build; xirang validate --change; git diff --check
seal.assessment: The reviewed implementation commit passed the complete template suite, lint, build, and Change validation. Independent baseline Review passed with no findings. Optimization was explicitly not performed because the prompt/projection scope has no evidence-backed optimization opportunity. A later commit updates only reviewer/apply workflow prompts to match this Quality CLI process; it does not alter the reviewed implementation or its test scope.
